datasheet_identity.title: SS12 THRU SS120 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Family datasheet SS12 THRU SS120; SS110 is the 100 V member (VRRM = VDC = 100 V, VRMS = 70 V, p. 1 Maximum Ratings).
Table column groupings verified on p. 2: VF max 0.85 V covers SS18-SS110; IR1 0.05 mA (25 degC) and IR2 10 mA (100 degC) cover SS18-SS120; CJ 90 pF covers SS14-SS120.
The 100 degC reverse-current row (IR2 = 10 mA max at VR = VDC) and the Fig. 4 Tj = 100 degC traces were not extracted; only 25 degC data is recorded.
Fig. 4 x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage and is preserved as published; multiply by 1 V per percent for SS110 to obtain volts.
No reverse recovery time and no measured breakdown row are published; the 100 V VRRM rating is a maximum rating, not a breakdown measurement, so breakdown fields are null.
Figs. 1-2 (current derating versus lead temperature and surge current versus cycles) are ratings curves and were not extracted.
Curve y-values were converted from the printed mA axes to SI amperes.
